notes.title: Starspangled Nerf; Knockback Nerf; other changes (1/22/2025)
notes.notes:
Due to a player finding out that Starspangled literally broke the game (as in almost making it crash), I realized both him knockback were so comically overpowered (and causing huge performance issues) that it was just removing the fun from the game, since the player could essentially stand there and kill everything without being touched once. There are several nerfs in this patch, which obviously will be subjected to change but for now make the game more balanced. There are also other changes

[*]Knockback now only affects enemies within 3 meters of the player. 
[*]Knockback can now only be inflicted by the player, not by anything that counts as a Turret.
[*]Knockback is now capped at 80%.
[*]Knockback has less of an effect on elite and boss enemies, the same as with damaging status effects (the higher the enemy’s rank, the less it will be affected).
[*]Starspangled now only gains 3% to basic damage types, rather than AOE, Melee and Explosive. He was able to stack insane amounts of damage on AOE + Explosive weapons, basically for doing nothing.
[*]Starspangled now has a permanent lock on his AOE / Melee size at -25%, making him more reliant on projectile weapons to knock enemies back.
[*]Starspangled’s Rivals and Checkers are now extremely powerful compared to other characters, making knocking them back essential to completing a run.

Other changes:

[*]Projectile Speed, Projectile Range, Projectile Size, AOE Size, Melee Size, have all been capped at 200%.
[*]Maxed out stats that have caps will now show when they are maxed on your Stats display.
[*]Yellow Card ‘Missed Leg Day’ now has a more extreme penalty, reducing your Health Recovery by 2.5% of your new Max HP.
[*]’Mini Machine’ now drops turrets with 20% of the main turrets’ HP, down from 50%.
[*]’Fresh Parts’ now has a 50% chance of giving +1 Turret Damage when picking up a material, rather than just +1 all the time.
[*]Magnet Demons now have higher health that scales off of your performance and pull your stuff quicker based on difficulty.
[*]Miasmis Demons now have higher health that scales off of your performance.
[*]Barrels from ‘Burner Phone’ now have a larger explosion to make them more punishing, and also have a sound when they explode now.
[*]’Burner Phone’ now has had its price raised to $1200, up from $800.

notes.title: New Music Track; Further Chest Changes; Other Fixes (1/17/2025)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]New Music track "Waltz for the End of the World" has been added as an unlockable. It can be achieved by ending a run with 500+ DPS. 
[*]Chest drops have heavily altered. When players with higher amounts of Upgrades go into lower difficulties, chest drops will be lowered significantly, thus encouraging players to try higher difficulty modes. In general, the high number of chest drops made them not feel as valuable, and felt excessive. I failed to notice this because I mostly tested on the final stage on Difficulty 3, therefore didn't know how many could drop if, say, a player went in with 80+ Upgrades and played on Difficulty 1 or 2.
[*]Fixed some further opacity issues with Ice Meteors.
[*]"You Can Break Me All Night" Black Card now has had its explosion animation changed and is now 150% bigger.
[*]The Demon Drone that randomly appears now has its health scale off of the player's performance, so you may have to chase it.
[*]The Assassin that you can summon from the "Thirsty" card now has health that scales off of the player's performance.
[*]FINALLY fixed the annoying bug that lasted for months where icons from some enemies (Enraged icons, etc) weren't disappearing.
[/list]

notes.title: Semi-big Thorns Update (10/17/2024)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Thorns can now do critical damage. [/b]Part of this was to make Miss Noxious more viable in Down Very Bad difficulty. Of all characters I've found her the most difficult to balance due to her unique ability to do insane amounts of damage (one shotting bosses), but also her squishiness in endgame. So she is a work in progress and I expect to work on her further down the line. However there is one Risky card that basically has the potential to make her the best character in the game, hence I was hesitant to buff her, but as is she is entirely card dependent. 
[*] [b]Thorns now works during invulnerability state[/b], but does not take damage, only gives damage. The same applies for Blowhole and his damage mechanic.
[*]On doing bonus stun damage, some of the weapons were tallying damage done incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor patch on Cash drop rates
notes.notes:
Cash drop rates have been increased by 300%. Later on in game cash becomes extremely plentiful and the game was designed to be a challenge to build up to the final levels of power, but I can understand how that can be frustrating. I figured it'd be offset by the number of heroes and combinations to increase replayability and challenge, so even with the increased cash drops I don't want players to be able to shoot to end game just like that.

If people still are upset I can continue to raise them until it feels right.
